question: Where does the expected legacy wallet-row construction first diverge from the frozen published data for one deterministically selected implicated transaction?

scope.inputs: The same frozen raw, resolved, root-expanded, published-clean, timestamp, token-map and resolution-cache inputs as the parent certification audit.
scope.preflight: Recompute footer/schema/clock fences and freeze input identity under the existing caps. Root reviews this fresh immutable manifest before any large-relation body read.
scope.source_context: Read every admitted raw/resolved row from complete fence blocks, not an isolated log or row group. Root/clean candidate context covers the entire minute, including all blocks sharing a timestamp.
scope.observation_unit: Native source record and its expected legacy maker/synthetic-counterparty representation. This is not a new economic-execution estimand.
scope.weighting_or_significance: None; exact identity, payload and multiplicity diagnosis only.
scope.completeness: Transaction completeness is relative to the frozen preserved OrderFilled relation. Independent receipt, token-transfer, chain collection and economic-counterparty-action completeness are not established.

selection.implication: An exact candidate-signature class whose expected wallet/counterparty multiset differs from the root-expanded class.
selection.rule: Select the first implicated transaction under the frozen ordering. Preserve ambiguity or absent candidates for that first transaction; never skip to an easier unique example.
selection.association_warning: The eight-field signature is candidate association only. Missing published native IDs prevent independently proven published transaction membership. Do not pair by row order, price/time alone, rounding or normalized wallet strings.
selection.collisions: Retain every native ID/role/transaction contributing to each selected signature, and every root/clean candidate payload class with exact multiplicity. No silent candidate truncation.

required_evidence: Every preserved raw log in the chosen source transaction, including existing aggregate exclusions, rank removals, absent mapping/resolution entries and price exclusions.
Exact native payload, cached timestamp and mapped metadata for each record; own-maker direction only when asset fields support it.
Expected eleven-field maker and synthetic-counterparty rows, with is_maker=false explicitly labeled inferred opposite action rather than verified economic action.
Whole-minute expected/root/clean candidate-class multiplicities and all contributing source identities, with collision uncertainty explicit.
Full eleven-field exact differences remain binding and data_certified=false; event-label omission or candidate signatures never relax that gate.
Separate source-history note on the known refresh.py label replacement; do not assume or replay an unproven historical cache/run linkage.
Committed script/helper hashes, exact count/fetch predicates, frozen input identities, stage completion and measured CPU/RSS/wall profile.
hard_gates: Production guard, expected canonical head, committed unchanged diagnostic/helper sources and unchanged production source blobs.
Complete published layout, schema and footer coverage; valid unique cached clock and touched metadata cardinality.
No conflicting native identities or differing-payload/emitter ties at the minimum log index of canonical rank-eligible transaction/order groups. Identical replay multiplicity is recorded separately.
Exact count/byte gates before fetch and identical predicates for count and fetch; never LIMIT or truncate to fit.
Full selected source transaction and complete same-second candidate context; no invented correspondence for ambiguous classes.
Input snapshots reopened after all reads; mutation, interruption, resource refusal or incomplete execution stays incomplete.
Immutable new run directories, finite exact JSON serialization and no data/cache/pipeline writes.

resources.io_note: Footprint and projected-pass estimates are not measured physical I/O. Record actual resource profile; resource failure cannot be converted into certification.

code_boundaries: scripts/audit_polymarket_lineage.py: backward-compatible preflight windows keyword and supplied-window loop only

publication.existing_completed_artifacts: Never overwritten or reinterpreted as passing
publication.reader_report: Technical audit evidence and chat explanation, not a new scientific-results report

not_authorized: Whole-history prevalence claims from this transaction
infrastructure: Root alone manages lifecycle/storage. Agents use only explicitly assigned already-running workloads. Finish transfers, confirm no remaining dependencies, stop EC2 and verify stopped before completing this task.
